name: focusguard
description: Open-Source-Browsererweiterung gegen Ablenkung: Website-Sperre, YouTube-Filter, Sperrmodus – komplett lokal.

scripts.test: node --test tests/core.test.js tests/features.test.js tests/background.test.js tests/background-features.test.js && node tests/static-scan.js
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e.test.js && node tests/blockpage.test.js && node tests/csp-probe.test.js
scripts.build: node tools/build.js && node tests/static-scan.js dist/chromium && node tests/static-scan.js dist/firefox
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:mutation && npm run build && node tests/e2e.test.js dist/chromium && node tests/blockpage.test.js dist/chromium && node tests/csp-probe.test.js dist/chromium
